validation.browserEvidence: This batch passed six managed-request cases and six existing replay-time cases across all three engines. The built website example exercised initial data, revision, provider replacement and confirmation controls in each engine. Screenshots were inspected. The preceding committed batch also passed the reported example autofit regression in all three engines: the scale expands when an extreme enters view and contracts when it leaves. Traffic uses fixtures rather than live brokers.
validation.budgetChange: Native request cancellation and lifecycle hooks increase base from 102.20 to 102.99 kB and chart-only from 61.71 to 62.38 KiB. Managed expressions increase the optional indicator tier from 33.59 to 35.05 kB. Limits are 103.25 kB base, 111.25 kB base plus trade, 35.25 kB indicators, 239 kB terminal, 278.5 kB all tiers and 62.5 KiB chart-only. Other optional-tier budgets are unchanged and removal checks pass.
validation.review: Independent review closed five findings covering custom-host receivers, replay interruption, initial source-state immutability, native calculation errors and style reattachment during request registration or provider invocation. Deferred-provider regressions also cover abort callback reentry, provider replacement, history correction and stale completion. The managed helper passes 38 cases, native request integration 29 cases and cancellation composition 19 cases.
validation.packageVerification: Verify passed lint, typecheck, 6811 unit tests, seven endurance-harness checks, build, 424 example tests and declaration identity. Measured feature growth required the documented budget adjustments; size and tree-shake checks then passed. Twelve compiled-program checks and public adapter typechecking passed.
